entries.question: The domain cannot depend on infra (HexagonalArchitectureTest), and MarkdownDocument is infra. How does Pack hold the document while being typed as #194's markdown value?
entries.rationale: ADR-0006 and HexagonalArchitectureTest keep packs.domain free of infra; #194 set the precedent (Guide + GuideMarkdown). The value keeps the markdown model's shape, so nothing of the form is rebuilt: parsing, canonical writing and comparison stay MarkdownCodec's (ADR-0042 d8, DM-01M60HM8).

entries.final_answer: Map.equals on the loaded YAML values (ADR-0040 as built); absent and empty frontmatter stay different models, numbers compare as loaded

entries.question: ADR-0040 leaves full ADR-0036 numeric and empty-versus-absent frontmatter equality to #260. Which equality does pack.md frontmatter use?
entries.rationale: The gate compares a source and a written pack.md read by the same reader, and the canonical writer emits the loaded values, so Map.equals on loaded values is exactly ADR-0036 meaning for a round trip; no numeric or empty-vs-absent drift can arise from our own write. The built-in pack.md has no frontmatter. ADR-0040 is amended to record the ruling; logged as an open review item for the operator.
